found_values.value: The one input a panel setting picks fills the BENCH rpm register and feeds the motor stall action. The panel already enables and places a rotation input by setting (SET_OPTICAL_EN 'Once per revolution, gives the phase', SET_OPTICAL_PIN 'GPIO'), and the BENCH page carries one rpm register (LINK_BN_RPM = 3) with one valid bit (LINK_BN_RPM_OK = 1u << 2). Each rotation input has its own front end and GPIO (Pins.md), none multiplexed, so any one can be picked. Derived from the tree

65,535 rpm: the highest speed the BENCH rpm register carries (to_u16 saturates at 65,535 counts of 1 rpm) and the speed V225, V290 and V292 compute at. A once-per-revolution input and the vibration fundamental reach 1,092.25 Hz; the phase-wire clip, which reads the electrical frequency (V293), reaches 22,937 Hz at 21 pole pairs (MOTOR_POLES even, 2 to 42). A commercial stand's electrical probe reads 0 to 190k eRPM ('Angular speed* 0 190k 1 eRPM')

No accelerometer shows the 1.244 us share under V225's ruling of 2026-10-02. The fixed delay of the RFILT x CX pole and its unit-to-unit spread now cancel: at CX = 4.7 nF ADXL316WBCSZ's pole sits at 915 to 1,254 Hz and delays 1,092 Hz by 104.40 to 127.26 us, the 22.86 us spread that failed FU-2D. What counts is the drift of one unit between runs. For a single pole the phase moves by (dRC/RC) x x / (1 + x^2) rad, x = 2 pi f RC; the share is 0.489 degree at every speed (1.244 us at 1,092 Hz, 8.16 us at 10,000 rpm), so where the pole sits inside 16.7 to 1,092 Hz, as every CX of 4.7 nF or more puts it, RFILT x CX may change by at most 1.71 % between runs (1.708 % at 32 kOhm; 72.8 us of delay per unit fractional change at 1,092 Hz). With a C0G CX the drift is RFILT's. ADXL316 Rev. C, ADXL326 Rev. 0 and the ADXL103/ADXL203 data sheet Rev. F (AD22035Z) state RFILT's tolerance (27 to 37 kOhm; 32 kOhm +/-15 %; 24 to 40 kOhm) but no temperature coefficient of RFILT and no phase or bandwidth over temperature; the sensor's own response (resonance 4.2 kHz typical for ADXL316, 5.5 kHz for AD22035) has no drift figure either; and the temperature change at the sensor between runs is not stated. ADXL316WBCSZ (JLCPCB 104) and AD22035Z (JLCPCB 83) pass every other value, rule 4 and the lead length with the buffer. At the IO board end the ADCS7476's sampling needs a series resistor and a reservoir capacitor (stage 2 passives): an RC of time constant tau adds about tau of delay at 1,092 Hz and drifts by tau times the fractional drift of R x C, for example 11 ns for tau = 110 ns and a 10 % change.
